claims.text: The Mariana Trench, the deepest point of the planet's surface, holds the ocean's strongest Grotto; Void Engineer explorers first reached it in 1960, and a few squads and two Tradition cabals have gone down since.
Some Tradition mages link it to the Umbral realm called the Chasm, which the Garou name the Abyss; Void Engineer teams there report hallucinations of vast drowned cities and monsters, none confirmed.

title: The Broken Chain
summary: Wraiths of the Middle Passage who hunt Thrall ships.

claims.text: Wraiths of enslaved people who died on the Middle Passage began riding the slave ships to reap the dead and seize crewmen who died aboard, then raided Stygian convoys.

Now one of the best organized Renegade groups, the Broken Chain attacks only ships carrying Thralls, ignoring relic cargo; freed Thralls and captured ships go to camps on the African coast, where Artificers forge captured Hierarchy crews into repairs and weapons.

title: The merfolk
summary: Sea fae who claim the oldest lineage.

claims.text: Merfolk never take mortal hosts and breed only among themselves, claiming to be the sole heirs of the Tuatha de Danaan, dreamed before humans walked on land; asked how, they turn vague.
Their society is matriarchal and feudal, built around avoiding humanity; they rarely draw Glamour from mortal dreams and fear Banality as death.

Each is bound to an Apsara, a sea creature such as a fish, seahorse, eel, shark, turtle, porpoise or even whale, which shapes house and standing: shark merfolk tend to be warriors, porpoise merfolk scholars.
